name: Akamura Shouma
source:
One of the new participants.

He is very flirtatious and often comments on women's appearances. He is usually very sly but seems smart on occasion.

[Edited from [url=https://wolf-game.fandom.com/wiki/Shouma_Akamura]Wolf Game Wiki[/url]]
